name: ima-opportunity-intelligence
description: Evaluate business opportunities with evidence, uncertainty, risk and reversible next actions.

interface.longDescription: A free-first decision-support app for evaluating business opportunities. It separates facts, assumptions, estimates and unknowns; assesses demand evidence, revenue clarity, acquisition friction, delivery cost, trust and risk, time-to-value and reversibility; then identifies the weakest link and proposes the cheapest zero-cost reversible test. It does not invent customers, demand, partners, prices or results, and it does not make purchases, payments, spam, signatures or external commercial commitments.
